# PureChecker

PureChecker verifies individual or batched email addresses for syntax, domain, deliverability, disposability, and risk signals.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/purechecker/.

## Actions

- **Check Email** (read-only): Check one email address and return PureChecker's detailed syntax, domain, mailbox, disposability, and risk signals.
- **Check Emails** (read-only): Check a batch of email addresses in one request and return PureChecker's verification signals for each address.
